    frozenset(), _original_type=None, child_relationship_class=None):
    seq = difflib.SequenceMatcher(isjunk=None, a=level.t1, b=level.t2, autojunk=False)
    
    opcodes = seq.get_opcodes()
    
    # Process opcodes to report differences
    for tag, t1_from_index, t1_to_index, t2_from_index, t2_to_index in opcodes:
        if tag == 'equal':
            continue
            
        if tag == 'replace':
            # For replacements, we need to compare each element individually
            t1_slice = level.t1[t1_from_index:t1_to_index]
            t2_slice = level.t2[t2_from_index:t2_to_index]
            
            # Compare element by element
            for i, (x, y) in enumerate(zip_longest(t1_slice, t2_slice, fillvalue=ListItemRemovedOrAdded)):
                if x is ListItemRemovedOrAdded:  # item added
                    change_level = level.branch_deeper(
                        notpresent,
                        y,
                        child_relationship_class=child_relationship_class,
                        child_relationship_param=t2_from_index + i,
                        child_relationship_param2=t2_from_index + i,
                    )
                    self._report_result('iterable_item_added', change_level, local_tree=local_tree)
                elif y is ListItemRemovedOrAdded:  # item removed
                    change_level = level.branch_deeper(
                        x,
                        notpresent,
                        child_relationship_class=child_relationship_class,

                        child_relationship_param2=t1_from_index + i,
                    )
                    self._report_result('iterable_item_removed', change_level, local_tree=local_tree)
                else:  # values changed

                        change_level = level.branch_deeper(

                        )
                        self._report_result('values_changed', change_level, local_tree=local_tree)
                        
        elif tag == 'delete':
            # Items removed from t1
            for i in range(t1_from_index, t1_to_index):

                    level.t1[i],
                    notpresent,
                    child_relationship_class=child_relationship_class,
                    child_relationship_param=i,
                    child_relationship_param2=i,
                )
                self._report_result('iterable_item_removed', change_level, local_tree=local_tree)

                    child_relationship_class=child_relationship_class,
                    child_relationship_param=i,
                    child_relationship_param2=i,
                )
                self._report_result('iterable_item_added', change_level, local_tree=local_tree)
